D E T A I L S

ADDRESS

Pune, Maharashtra

India

PHONE 8485887011

EMAIL

Khanuzer9637 @gmail.com

C O R E S K I L S

Payment Lifecycle Management, SWIFT MT/MX Messaging, Business Requirement Gathering, User Stories & Acceptance Criteria, BPMN Process Modelling, REST API, Exposure to AI tools for workflow optimization (Claude, Chat GPT, Co-pilot)

L A N G U A G E S

English

Hindi

UZER KHAN

BUSINESS ANALYST

P R O F I L E

Payments Business Analyst with 7+ years of experience, including 5 years in payments, banking, and financial services. Skilled in gathering and analyzing

business requirements, managing stakeholders, creating user stories, supporting UAT, and delivering solutions in Agile environments. Strong knowledge of end-to-end payment lifecycle and standards, including ISO 20022, SWIFT MT/MX, CBPR+, ACH, Fedwire, SEPA, cross-border payments, real-time payments, and

large-scale transformation initiatives. Proven ability to bridge business and technology teams to deliver efficient and compliant payment solutions.

T O O L S

JIRA/Confluence | ServiceNow | Swagger | SQL | Power BI | Power Apps | MS Visio

(BPMN 2.0) | MS Office

P R O J E C T S

Cross-Border Payments Modernization & ISO 20022 Adoption

MT-MX message analysis and data mapping to support ISO 20022 payment transformation initiatives.

P R O F E S S I O N A L E X P E R I E N C E

Senior Associate Consultant, Infosys Limited

Apr 2024 — May 2026

Partnered with payment operations, product, and technology teams to deliver requirements documentation, stakeholder alignment, and UAT support across a multi-workstream USD clearing ISO 20022 migration spanning CHIPS, Fedwire, and SWIFT.

Performed field-level gap analysis between legacy SWIFT MT message formats and ISO 20022 MX equivalents, documenting data impacts on reconciliation workflows and straight-through processing for cross-border payment flows.

Authored business requirements for structured address compliance and

exception-handling workflow changes, working with operations and client onboarding teams to identify and close data-quality gaps ahead of industry

deadlines.

Supported execution of UAT business scenarios covering transaction

submission, payment tracking, inquiry management, status updates, and exception workflows for CashPro platform enhancements.

Assessed CashPro client impact of ISO 20022 changes for corporate clients initiating payments via API and file-based channels, coordinating with product and technology teams on required formatting changes.

Pune

Finance Program & Operations Analyst, Accenture

Bengaluru

Jun 2022 — Apr 2024

Performed business analysis across finance and operational workflows identifying process gaps, bottlenecks, and automation opportunities. • Created AS-IS and TO-BE process flows using BPMN 2.0.2 concepts for operational improvement initiatives.

Supported requirement clarification, functional documentation, workflow

optimization, and stakeholder coordination activities.

Coordinated functional testing, UAT activities, data validation, and defect

tracking using SQL and reporting tools.

Contributed to process governance documentation, SOP standardization, and

continuous improvement initiatives.

Process Analyst, Gallagher Service Center

Pune

May 2019 — Feb 2022

Managed end-to-end domestic and international payment processing

operations using Citibank Citi Treasury & Trade Solutions / CitiDirect platform.

Processed high-value and bulk payment transactions including Wire Transfers,

ACH Push & Pull payments, Direct Deposits, SWIFT, SEPA, and Fedwire transactions through manual maker-checker workflows.

Worked with batch payment processing using XML-based payment files

aligned with ISO 20022 payment messaging standards.

Gained exposure to treasury banking operations, payment lifecycle management, cross-border payment flows, and structured financial messaging concepts.

Customer Service Advisor, Concentrix Daksh

Pune

Jul 2017 — Apr 2018

Provided customer support for Amazon North America via calls, email, and chat

for pre- and post-order queries.

Handled refunds, replacements, and order issue resolution within SLA

timelines.

Managed escalations and ensured high customer satisfaction through timely

and quality service.

E D U C A T I O N

Bachelors in Business Administration (IB), Indira college of Commerce and science, Pune Jun 2014 — Apr 2018

Specialization in International Business

C E R T I F I C A T I O N S

CPME (Certified Payment Messaging Expert)

MVLCO

Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO)

AI Certification Course for Business Analysts

TECHCANVASS
